    • addFile

      public ORSResponse addFile(org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, String description, UserContext ctx)
      Entry point for other controllers that call this bean directly (a plain Java method call, not an HTTP request) and already have a UserContext resolved for the current request - e.g. UserCtl uploading a profile photo. A direct call bypasses the @ModelAttribute that normally populates this.userContext, so it must be passed in explicitly.

    • download

      @GetMapping("/pub/file/{id}") @ResponseBody public void download(@PathVariable long id, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response)
      Downloads a document for the given id. Excluded from JWT auth (see ORSApp interceptor config for "/doc/pub/file/**"), so this is reachable without a Bearer token - only put data here that's fine to be publicly accessible.
      Parameters:
